recognize_zh: 三張小腿臨床照片：A 為散在、中央壞死結痂的潰瘍性丘疹／結節與周圍紅斑；B 為大片融合的黑色壞死痂與滲出潰瘍；C 治療後潰瘍癒合，只留色素沉著與萎縮疤痕。快速進展的壞死潰瘍病灶要想到侵襲性表皮向性 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞淋巴瘤，但確診需靠切片與免疫染色。
features: Clinical photographs of the lower leg in three time points (A, B, C)
A: multiple scattered ulcerated papulonodules with central black necrotic crusts on erythematous, purpuric background
B: extensive confluent necrotic eschar with exudative ulceration, crusting and surrounding scale
C: healed skin with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, atrophic scars and residual pink macules
No histologic information available in the image
describe_en: Clinical photographs of the lower leg document disease evolution. Panel A shows multiple scattered erythematous papulonodules with central ulceration and black necrotic crusts; panel B shows progression to a large confluent necrotic, exudative ulcer with eschar; panel C shows healing after chemotherapy with hyperpigmentation and atrophic scarring. These appearances indicate a rapidly progressive ulceronecrotic cutaneous process but are not specific. Diagnosis of primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma requires biopsy demonstrating pagetoid epidermotropic atypical CD8+ cytotoxic T cells.

ddx.vs: It also forms necrotic ulcerated plaques but the atypical cells are TCR-gamma/delta positive and usually CD8-negative, often with panniculitic involvement.
It shows angiocentric necrosis with CD56+ cells that are EBER-positive, whereas the aggressive CD8+ epidermotropic lymphoma is EBV-negative and here CD56-negative.

ddx.dx: Lymphomatoid papulosis type D or CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: LyP type D mimics CD8+ epidermotropism but is strongly CD30+ with self-healing papules, whereas this case is CD30-negative and progressive.
These show neutrophil-rich or microbial ulcers without an atypical clonal-appearing CD8+ epidermotropic T-cell infiltrate on biopsy.
